endpoint.description: Per-team post-match team statistics; stored-only; provider says upstream posts after full time and persists hourly.
endpoint.goals_source: match linescore; statistics endpoint description says linescore remains authoritative for goals

hold_reasons: OpenAPI x-bbs-min-plan and endpoint description say Free, while the dedicated Serie A capability matrix says Edge; the Serie A FAQ says Free. No authenticated Free-plan response was reviewed.
The route is post-match and stored-only. It can only supply lagged inputs to a later fixture after a separately authorized capture.

The provider documents hourly persistence but does not document per-match upstream first-observation or per-field correction timestamps. Local receipt time and SHA-256 prove project possession before a later quote, not upstream first observation.
Current-season per-fixture completeness for corners, yellow cards and red cards is not verified; aggregate all-season coverage is not a current-season guarantee.
The provider's terms permit private storage and internal model use but prohibit raw-feed redistribution; upstream field-level rights and retention after account termination remain unresolved.
The project has no approved private archive destination for this provider. No account, key, API call, download, feature build or inference is authorized.
